en.question: I control an <<5323>>, whose effects are negated by the effect of <<15278>>. What happens if I Tribute that <<5323>> to activate its effect?
en.title: What happens if a monster, whose effects are negated by <<15278>>'s effect, Tributes itself to activate its effect?

ja.title: 「<<15278>>」の『②』の効果が適用されたモンスターが自身をリリースして効果を発動した場合、処理はどうなりますか？
